description: Permanently delete a registered application (app_id) along with all of its subscriber device tokens, scheduled campaigns, and delivery history. Use this tool only when a user explicitly asks to remove a duplicate or decommissioned app; do not use it to pause notifications or change app settings (use update_app_branding or configure_inapp_banner instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to verify the exact app_id and active subscriber count. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY, costs 0 credits, and is irreversibly destructive (confirm_delete must be set to true or the call is rejected). Returns JSON { ok, deleted_app_id, deleted_site_name, subscribers_removed }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx to permanently delete (obtain from list_apps)

confirm_delete.description: Safety confirmation flag: must be explicitly set to true to execute permanent deletion

name: delete_app
